steps.what: Piece sounds together to develop film soundtracks and judge their effect against picture

tasks.design: Retain soundtrack construction in the audio editing application in {OTHER}. Existing placement, playback and mixing controls support the editor's choices about how sounds work with picture.
tasks.previous_blocker: The effect of combining sounds depends on timing, transitions, balance and narrative purpose.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing audio editing already supports assembly; no new creative breakthrough is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: A technically aligned soundtrack can still obscure dialogue or damage the intended mood.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the whole sequence and judge how its layers serve the film.
tasks.altitude: Soundtrack judgement and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check sound playback and technical delivery

evidence.claim: Soundtrack construction is retained creative work; the digest's transcript and rough-picture editing capabilities do not establish savings in layered sound design.

assumptions: OTHER means an audio editing application. Boundary is constructing the soundtrack, not selecting broad requirements4055, discussing them4071 or duplicate sound insertion4052. The same timeline operation has one owner in a role roll-up.

Production supplies current picture and source sounds before assembly. Editor produces asset IDs/versions, timing, tracks, transitions, levels and intended relationships during retained100 hours. No pre-existing complete cue map or acceptable-mix flag is assumed; unclear cues require manual listening and clarification.
Try native editing and mixing controls before custom tools; existing rendering and playback runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool, generated assets or transferred duty is introduced.
unknowns: Division of work with sound specialists
research_questions: Which repeated sound operations are genuinely separate from listening and creative judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Creative sound assembly retains time; existing automatic playback is not new labour saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on editing approaches and dramatic value

steps.what: Confer with producers and directors about editing approaches that increase dramatic or entertainment value

tasks.design: Keep the creative discussion with the editor, producer and director using {TELEPHONY} and versioned examples in {DOCS}. The conversation establishes a shared intention rather than selecting an approach from a fixed score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different creative interpretations need discussion and tradeoffs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication and cut references support the discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Dramatic value cannot be reduced to a transcript match or technical completion check.
tasks.human_edge: Understand reactions, challenge weak choices and reach a shared creative direction.
tasks.altitude: Creative collaboration and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How framing and performance affect editing options

evidence.claim: Creative discussion remains human; the digest's rough-cut capability does not establish shorter producer/director deliberation.

assumptions: Boundary is discussing approaches, not creating the alternative edits or conducting a full screening. Overlapping discussion during4069 is assigned once. Existing producer/director participation remains outside and unchanged.

Editor brings the exact cut/version and examples before related discussion; producer and director supply reactions during the conversation before agreement. Clarification and decision notes sit in retained100 hours. No free agreed-approach or entertainment-quality flag is assumed; unresolved intent requires further human discussion.
Native communication and shared examples precede custom tools; no automatic creative decision is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing process and tools remain unchanged.
research_questions: Which disagreements require a shared viewing example before they can be resolved?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Substantive creative discussion retains time even when cuts are easier to share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop post-production models for films and assess how they express the intended production

tasks.design: Retain development of the post-production model in the editing application in {OTHER}, with the intended brief in {DOCS}. Confirm the required model type before choosing any repeatable automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task does not specify a standard model type or fixed transformation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing editing tools support trial outputs; no new generic automation gain is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: An example or trial assembly must represent the intended film rather than merely fill a template.
tasks.human_edge: Choose what the model should demonstrate and judge its creative adequacy.
tasks.altitude: Model development time and creative responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check whether a proposed post-production approach can be delivered

evidence.claim: Retaining human development is a model-knowledge boundary choice because the task does not identify a standard model artefact; no measured saving is established.

assumptions: OTHER means a video editing application. Interpret post-production models provisionally as trial or example film outputs, not a statistical AI model or an invented project scheduling task. The exact customer artefact must be confirmed. Any trial editing shared with other editing tasks is assigned once.

Producer supplies the intended purpose and available material before related development; editor clarifies model type, source versions, constraints and acceptance questions within retained100 hours. No free structured creative specification or model-quality flag is assumed; unclear scope remains a human clarification.
Test native editing features once the artefact is known before custom code. Existing rendering runtime earns no new labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or process is proposed.
unknowns: Meaning and format of post-production models locally
Existing reusable elements and acceptance process
research_questions: What concrete artefact is called a post-production model, and which parts are repeated rather than creative?

already_counted.description: Scope clarification, model development and creative assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Without a defined repeatable model artefact, no development time is removed or machine runtime counted as human effort.
